```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
auto_dark_setup <- c(
  "_extensions/thomashusson29/auto-dark/auto-dark-setup.R",
  "_extensions/auto-dark/auto-dark-setup.R"
)
auto_dark_setup <- auto_dark_setup[file.exists(auto_dark_setup)]
if (!length(auto_dark_setup)) {
  stop("Cannot find auto-dark-setup.R. Run `quarto add thomashusson29/quarto_auto_dark_theme` first.")
}
source(auto_dark_setup[[1]])
auto_dark_on()

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)
library(flowchart)
library(forestplot)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(pROC)
```

## ggplot2

```{r}
#| label: fig-ggplot
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-cap: "A ggplot2 figure with a legend and a fitted line."
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Weight", y = "Miles per gallon", color = "Cylinders") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## Base R

```{r}
#| label: fig-base-r
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-cap: "A base R plot."
plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg, pch = 19, col = "#2A6F97", xlab = "Weight", ylab = "MPG")
abline(lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars), col = "#e06c75", lwd = 2)
```

## flowchart

```{r}
#| label: fig-flowchart
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-cap: "A flowchart rendered by the flowchart package."
flow_data <- tibble(
  id = seq_len(120),
  eligible = id <= 96,
  analysed = id <= 84
)

flow_data |>
  flowchart::as_fc(
    label = "Screened",
    text_pattern = "{label}\nN = {N}",
    bg_fill = "#f7f7f7",
    border_color = "#2f4858"
  ) |>
  flowchart::fc_filter(eligible, label = "Eligible", bg_fill = "#e8f1f2") |>
  flowchart::fc_filter(analysed, label = "Analysed", bg_fill = "#e8f1f2") |>
  flowchart::fc_draw()
```

## forestplot

```{r}
#| label: fig-forestplot
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-cap: "A forestplot figure."
forestplot::forestplot(
  labeltext = cbind(
    c("Variable", "Age", "Diabetes", "ASA 3-4"),
    c("OR [95% CI]", "1.20 [0.95; 1.51]", "1.85 [1.10; 3.11]", "0.82 [0.50; 1.34]")
  ),
  mean = c(NA, 1.20, 1.85, 0.82),
  lower = c(NA, 0.95, 1.10, 0.50),
  upper = c(NA, 1.51, 3.11, 1.34),
  zero = 1,
  boxsize = 0.18,
  col = forestplot::fpColors(box = "#2A6F97", line = "#2A6F97", zero = "#555555")
)
```

## CART and ROC

```{r}
#| label: fig-cart
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.8
#| fig-cap: "A CART plot rendered by rpart.plot."
#| fig-keep: last
cart_fit <- rpart::rpart(factor(am) ~ mpg + wt + cyl, data = mtcars)
rpart.plot::rpart.plot(cart_fit, type = 2, extra = 104, fallen.leaves = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-roc
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-cap: "A ROC curve rendered as ggplot."
roc_obj <- pROC::roc(mtcars$am, mtcars$mpg, quiet = TRUE)
pROC::ggroc(roc_obj, colour = "#61afef", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e06c75") +
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## include_graphics

```{r}
#| label: make-local-image
#| include: false
dir.create("generated", showWarnings = FALSE)
local_image <- "generated/include-graphics-demo.png"

png(local_image, width = 900, height = 360, res = 120, bg = "white")
par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
plot(pressure, type = "b", pch = 19, col = "#2A6F97", xlab = "Temperature", ylab = "Pressure")
grid(col = "#dddddd")
title("Local PNG inserted with knitr::include_graphics()")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-include-graphics
#| out-width: "70%"
#| fig-cap: "A local PNG inserted with knitr::include_graphics()."
knitr::include_graphics(local_image)
```

## gtsummary and gt

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gtsummary
gtsummary::trial |>
  select(age, grade, trt) |>
  tbl_summary(by = trt, missing = "no") |>
  add_p() |>
  as_gt()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gt
mtcars |>
  head(6) |>
  select(mpg, cyl, wt, am) |>
  gt()
```
